div.head: Northu 60
div.ab: Gif hwa teoðinge forhealde ⁊ he sy cyninges þegn, gilde X healfmarc, landagende VI healfmarc, ceorl XII ór.
If anyone withholds tithes and he is a king's thegn, he is to pay 10 half-marks; a landowner [is to pay] six half-marks, a ceorl 12 ores.
If anyone holds back his tithes and he is a king's thegn, his is to pay ten half-marks, a landholder six half-marks, a peasant twelve ores.
Wenn einer Zehnten vorenthält und er ist Königsthegn, zahle er 10 Halbmark, ein Grundeigner [ohne Hofdienstadel] 6 Halbmark, ein Gemeinfreier 12 Ör.
If anyone withholds tithe and he is a king's thegn, let him pay 10 half-marks; a land-owner [without court-service nobility] 6 half-marks; a ceorl 12 ores.
